themes.title: Transnational Recalibration Following MAGA Midterm Defeats
themes.blurb: Far-right and right-wing parties across Europe, Latin America, and North America are recalibrating their public messaging following the US Republican midterm defeat. Leaders in the UK, Italy, Germany, and Argentina are either distancing themselves from Donald Trump's foreign policy—particularly the war in Iran—or enforcing tactical silence to insulate their domestic brands from contagion.

countries.name: 🇺🇸 MAGA / Trump
countries.note: Faces severe post-midterm fallout with Democratic majorities in Congress, cabinet infighting over the Iran war, and impeachment efforts against Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth.

countries.name: 🇬🇧 Reform UK
countries.note: Nigel Farage publicly attacked Trump's foreign policy choices, blaming the Iran intervention for the Republican midterm defeat.

countries.name: 🇮🇹 Fratelli d'Italia / Lega
countries.note: Giorgia Meloni instructed party figures to avoid commenting on US elections, while coalition figures highlighted their distance from MAGA rhetoric.

countries.name: 🇩🇪 Alternative für Deutschland
countries.note: Sparked an internal factional dispute over foreign policy and its long-term strategic alignment with Trump post-midterms.

countries.name: 🇦🇷 La Libertad Avanza
countries.note: Faced political mocking from opposition figures due to Milei's alignment with MAGA, prompting US diplomats to publicly reaffirm support.

themes.title: Transnational Right-Wing Networking and Parallel Diplomacy
themes.blurb: Prominent right-wing leaders continue to utilize international summits and conservative forums to build ideological solidarity and circumvent domestic pressures. High-profile engagements—such as Flávio Bolsonaro attending CPAC in Florida and Javier Milei meeting Vox's Santiago Abascal in Madrid—demonstrate active transnational right-wing coordination.

countries.name: 🇧🇷 Bolsonarismo / Partido Liberal
countries.note: Flávio Bolsonaro traveled to Florida to address CPAC at Mar-a-Lago alongside US conservative figures amid domestic legal scrutiny.

countries.name: 🇦🇷 La Libertad Avanza
countries.note: Javier Milei attended the Ibero-American Summit in Madrid, prioritizing a meeting with Vox's Santiago Abascal while clashing with Spain's government.

countries.name: 🇪🇸 Vox
countries.note: Santiago Abascal hosted Javier Milei in Madrid to reinforce transatlantic right-wing ties ahead of regional election rallies.

countries.name: 🇮🇹 Fratelli d'Italia / Lega
countries.note: Italian authorities faced political scrutiny regarding fast-tracked citizenship applications for members of the Bolsonaro family.

themes.title: Judicial Crackdowns and Surveillance Targeting the Far-Right
themes.blurb: Right-wing parties in several nations report being targeted by state judicial organs, intelligence files, and parliamentary probes, framing these events as institutional persecution. From secret service file errors in Hungary to high-stakes constitutional battles in Poland and ongoing judicial pressure in Brazil and France, right-wing factions are weaponizing claims of state bias.

countries.note: The Tisza Party faced espionage investigations by prosecutors while an IT file release error mistakenly tagged former officials as communist secret agents.

countries.name: 🇵🇱 Prawo i Sprawiedliwość

countries.name: 🇧🇷 Bolsonarismo / Partido Liberal
countries.note: The Bolsonaro family faces ongoing STF investigations, military court delays over rank loss, and travel-related legal challenges.

countries.name: 🇫🇷 Rassemblement National
countries.note: Marine Le Pen faces potential legal ineligibility threats for 2027 while the party reported a major cyberattack targeting member data.

themes.title: Far-Right Momentum and Electoral Contestation Ahead of Major Votes
themes.blurb: Populist right-wing parties are adjusting coalition strategies and pushing aggressive policy demands ahead of regional and national votes. In Sweden, Spain, Poland, and Germany, right-wing formations are either dropping executive preconditions to secure governance influence or breaking local mainstream political cordons sanitaires.

countries.name: 🇸🇪 Sverigedemokraterna
countries.note: Jimmie Åkesson dropped demands for cabinet seats to break post-election deadlock and facilitate Ulf Kristersson's prime ministerial candidacy.

countries.name: 🇪🇸 Vox
countries.note: Leveraged budget negotiations across regions like Aragón and Zaragoza to enforce policy concessions ahead of the 29-N elections.

countries.name: 🇵🇱 Prawo i Sprawiedliwość
countries.note: PiS and Konfederacja polled neck-and-neck as right-wing voters consolidated behind hardline opposition stances.

countries.name: 🇩🇪 Alternative für Deutschland
countries.note: Continued to breach municipal firewalls as local CDU and Green politicians voted alongside AfD candidates.

themes.title: National Priority Rhetoric and Hardline Migration Demands
themes.blurb: Conservative and far-right movements are escalating calls for national sovereignty, economic protectionism, and stricter identity policies. Factions across Western Europe are driving agendas centered on local industrial protection, welfare preference for citizens, and restriction of religious attire or foreign influence.

countries.name: 🇪🇸 Vox
countries.note: Demanded strict border enforcement in Ceuta and eliminated regional foreign aid allocations in favor of local trade protection.

countries.name: 🇸🇪 Sverigedemokraterna
countries.note: Promoted stricter citizenship rules as a democratic imperative while leading debates over Swedish cultural identity.

countries.name: 🇬🇧 Reform UK
countries.note: Pushed to renew parliamentary debates on full-face veil bans and strongly criticized government immigration adjustments.

countries.name: 🇫🇷 Rassemblement National
countries.note: Demanded national priority rules on public spending and pension qualifications amidst national budget debates.
